turns.answer: That is a fair question, but I can't confirm it from the published property data, and these rules change and differ by country. Please check with the official bodies: Saudi Arabia: the Real Estate General Authority; Oman: the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning; UAE: the land department of the relevant emirate; UK: HM Land Registry; Qatar: the Ministry of Justice. A DarGlobal advisor can explain the process for international buyers; the official get-in-touch page is linked below. In the meantime I'm happy to keep exploring properties with you, for example in Saudi Arabia, Oman, United Arab Emirates.

banner.text: REAL MODEL ANSWERS: numbers measure the live pool

notes: Numbers checks use retrieved/card ids from the trace; they are a proxy for 'in context'.
live_sample cases are sampled from the DB (scraped from live sites); the runner never contacts the live sites.
Judge scores (Gemini, --judge gemini) are reported separately and never change a deterministic pass/fail; without the flag every check is deterministic.
CIs: Wilson 95% for proportions, percentile bootstrap for TTFT p95. n is small, so intervals are wide.
llm_calls_counted counts every attempt (retries included) as one request: a ceiling, not a measurement.
